investigation_notes.Scriptblock: Get-ChildItem C:\Users -Recurse -Include *.kdbx,*.pst,*.docx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,Length | Export-Csv C:\ProgramData\user_cache.csv -NoTypeInformation
investigation_notes.Description: The PowerShell command recursively enumerates C:\Users for *.kdbx, *.pst, and *.docx files and exports results to C:\ProgramData\user_cache.csv, indicating potential targeted data collection of credentials/mailbox and documents. There are no VirusTotal or AbuseIPDB indicators available for this alert and no historical events or similar alerts to suggest benign maintenance. Because this activity involves harvesting sensitive file types on a finance server by a non-service user account with no prior benign context, it is considered high risk and prioritized accordingly.
